content: To save you from scrolling back like I had to, the "Left" is the 4,3,2,1 part. I guess thats what "Positions 4-1" mean. <facepalm>
Same here.  I had no problem putting in the board.  I used the torx screwdriver to push down the sleeves, as they had in the picture.  And there actually is a LOUD click.
The order here is bad.  The sleeves from step 42 should be inserted after the board because they prevent it from properly seating flush.

replies.content: I didn't have any trouble seating the board with the sleeves from step 42 already installed.

I installed the sleeves first as in the instructions and the circuit board sat flush, no problems. If the sleeves are not fully seated, and they take some effort to do so, then the circuit board will not sit correctly.
